commands.name: shortcut_list
commands.description: Lists every shortcut, at the top level and in folders, with its folder, action count and whether it accepts input.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: Must be "background": it uses Shortcuts Events, the app's own scripting.

example_requests: Which folder is my backup shortcut in?
commands.precondition: The calling process has macOS's Automation permission for Shortcuts Events (a person allows it once; nothing here answers that prompt).

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: an argument is invalid or mode isn't "ui" or "background"

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: a named element never appeared, a Shortcuts Events call failed, or the result wasn't seen in time

errors.name: NotSupported
errors.when: mode is "ui"

known_gaps: Verified on macOS 15.6.1 with Shortcuts 7.0 (3612.0.2.1) only, so it isn't known to work on macOS 26 or any other version.

commands.name: shortcut_run
commands.description: Runs a shortcut by name in the background through Shortcuts Events, optionally with text input, and returns its output as text.

args.name: input
args.meaning: Text passed as the shortcut's input.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: Must be "background": it uses Shortcuts Events, the app's own scripting.

example_requests: Run the shortcut called Backup Notes
What does my Random Pick shortcut give me?
commands.precondition: The calling process has macOS's Automation permission for Shortcuts Events (a person allows it once; nothing here answers that prompt).
commands.postcondition: The shortcut ran once (whatever it does).

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: an argument is invalid or mode isn't "ui" or "background"

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: a named element never appeared, a Shortcuts Events call failed, or the result wasn't seen in time

errors.name: NotFound
errors.when: no shortcut (or folder) has that name

errors.name: Ambiguous
errors.when: two shortcuts share the name; nothing was done

errors.name: NotSupported
errors.when: mode is "ui"

errors.name: PermissionNeeded
errors.when: Shortcuts asks to allow the shortcut access (for example to save files), or such a question is already on screen; it's left for a person and nothing is answered

known_gaps: Verified on macOS 15.6.1 with Shortcuts 7.0 (3612.0.2.1) only, so it isn't known to work on macOS 26 or any other version.
A shortcut that reads or saves files makes Shortcuts ask once per shortcut; the call refuses at that question (PermissionNeeded) and never answers it.
output is None unless the shortcut ends with Stop and Output (or another output); a non-text output is returned as AppleScript's text for it.
Input to a shortcut that doesn't take input wasn't tested.

commands.name: shortcut_delete
commands.description: Deletes a shortcut: the library is searched for its name, Edit > Select All and Edit > Delete, and Shortcuts' question is confirmed only once it names that shortcut.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: Must be "ui": Shortcuts Events accepts delete but nothing is deleted.

example_requests: Get rid of my Draft Backup shortcut
commands.precondition: The program has Accessibility, Automation for System Events, and Automation for Shortcuts Events.
commands.postcondition: The shortcut is gone from Shortcuts (it can't be restored from the trash).

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: an argument is invalid or mode isn't "ui" or "background"

errors.name: Ambiguous
errors.when: two shortcuts share the name, or the library's search for it also shows other shortcuts (whose names contain it); nothing was deleted

errors.name: StateBlocked
errors.when: a Shortcuts sheet, file panel or privacy question is open, or another app came to the front; nothing was done
